name: Stormcrag Crypt
summary: Stormcrag Crypt is an ancient Nordic tomb in southeastern Eastmarch, south of Jorunn's Stand containing draugr. Rats and torchbugs are found in numbers within. Hazards include: Flame Walls. There are more than a dozen bookshelves in the crypt. The Deathknight Stormcrag can be found in the northeastern chamber.
